text:
julia: Quick sync — SummitBoard joint bench with partner next week. We need perf/W sweep + kernel knob pass. Who's available to own matrix and telemetry?
rashid: I can own kernel tuning and the knob list. will push initial patches to our fork.
sophia: I'll handle telemetry and ingestion into benchdb. Need the schema for power samples.
julia: Awesome. @rashid can you share expected driver flags? Also need target seq lengths and batch sizes.
rashid: initial plan: seq=[512,1024,2048], batch=[1,4,8], quant=fp16/int8. Driver flags: `--kernel=asm_v2 --prefetch=2 --warp=64` (draft).
mike: Can we also capture tail latency p95/p99? Ops wants allocations for Dedicated during the run.
sophia: yes p50/p95/p99 + energy-per-token. Benchbot will annotate runs with git sha and hw serial.
benchbot: [bot] scheduled run created: run_id=sb-2026-03-28-01, owner=julia, duration=6h
julia: Perfect. Let's lock calendar: partner asked for Wed 9-15 UTC. Can we do Wed 10-16 UTC instead?
rashid: Wed 10-16 works. We'll need 2 racks dedicated for hot runs + one for dry runs.
mike: I'll request Dedicated capacity and mark a canary route to fallback to smaller model if cluster noisy.
sophia: telemetry schema: `tags: [run_id, model, hw_rev] metrics: [power_w, tokens, latency_ms]` I'll push to benchdb before Monday.
julia: Also marketing wants a joint blog + marketplace listing. Tentative embargo: results embargoed until Apr 5. @mike FYI for announcements.
mike: noted. DM with partner contact so we align on wording. Also will add a short "how we measured" appendix.
rashid: quick note: kernel patch might change perf ~2-5% on 2048 seq. we should run patch vs baseline A/B.
julia: Good call. Add A/B on the matrix. I'll update the run matrix and share the spreadsheet shortly.
sophia: anything else? power clamp from partner is 330W nominal, can we do a sweep 250-330 with 10 steps?
rashid: 10 steps fine. schedule will slow down run time — accounted in run duration.
julia: thanks all. I'll share final matrix and invite partner engineers to the channel. :thumbsup:
